gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-copse: Copse reads like a well-worn paperback, its curves showing plenty of daylight. Red Hat Display sits above it with a marker-like line of constant width, so a long page feels bold on top and gently literary below.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-cutive: Red Hat Display draws each word like bent wire, one steady line with daylight inside every curve. And Cutive handles the quieter work below, spacing its running text wide and giving the c a generous opening.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-david-libre: Marker-bold up top, dignified below. Red Hat Display never swings between thick and thin, while David Libre lets its terminals hang open, and that gap between them is the pair's best quality.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-diphylleia: Diphylleia reads bookish and sturdy, its openings staying clear even at tiny sizes. Red Hat Display adds a flat, bold line overhead, so curves and stems move in lockstep above a body with a slight pinch where bowls meet stems.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-donegal-one: Red Hat Display ends every stroke at the same measured thickness, giving the heading a contemporary, bold look. Donegal One meets that with a classic serif texture, lightly shaded through each word, and the two feel authoritative yet modern together.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-enriqueta: Flat, single-weight linework gives Red Hat Display a bold, contemporary front, with daylight inside every curve. Enriqueta sits below, chalky and literary, its curves stopping short of closing.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-fenix: Fenix reads like an editorial classic serif, its curved strokes ending before they turn inward. Red Hat Display brings a single line weight on top, and that crisp, bold contrast is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-fjord-one: Fjord One reads refined and editorial, with wide-mouthed round letters and a gentle weight change in its bowls. Red Hat Display does the gliding, a wire-like line that moves under the eye, while Fjord One quietly keeps the eye from snagging.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gentium-book-p: Red Hat Display has no pinched joins and no swelling bowls, just one marker-like line with daylight in every curve. And Gentium Book Plus brings a classic serif's lighter horizontals and wide openings, thinning gently at the joins.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-gentium-plus: Quiet and level, Red Hat Display keeps a steady beat with no accents of weight, and Gentium Plus follows in classic, refined serif form. Its pitcher-wide c keeps a long page easy going.
